beaches.name: Platia–Varades (Therma)
beaches.summary: A 500 m nudist stretch is designated east of the Platia camping, towards Varades. The Samothraki municipal council approved the designation unanimously on 6 April 2026 as a pilot, on a proposal by three local professional associations, shifting it 300 m west and shortening it from 800 m to 500 m. Councillors noted in the same meeting that nudism elsewhere remains prohibited under art. 353 of the penal code.

beaches.name: Kipos
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix along the pebble beach, naturists usually in the majority. A naturist directory carries reports from 2016 to August 2024 and a regional press listicle lists it among Greek nudist beaches. The beach designated by the municipality in April 2026 is a different one, near Therma.
